data.body_html:
Marbella’s 2033 sunset season starts at Puerto Banús. The photoshoot yacht sunset session aboard the Astondoa 40 gives you 2 hours of golden-hour light, a private skipper, and a full drinks bar – all for €749 total. No per-person pricing, no hidden extras. Just you, your crew (up to 9 guests), and the Mediterranean turning amber behind La Concha.

This page covers the boat, the route, the timing, and exactly what you get. If you’re planning a content shoot, engagement photos, or just want frame-worthy sunset shots, this is the most cost-effective way to do it from Marbella.

Why the Astondoa 40 works for a sunset photoshoot

The Astondoa 40 is a 12.5-metre flybridge motor yacht. It has a large open aft deck, a forward sunpad, and a flybridge with 360° visibility. That means your photographer can move between three shooting positions without climbing through cabins. The white hull and blue upholstery reflect golden-hour light naturally – no harsh shadows.

  • Length: 12.5 m
  • Capacity: 9 guests maximum
  • Departure: Puerto Banús (5 min walk from the port’s main entrance)
  • Included: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, IVA (21%)

You don’t need a boat licence. The skipper handles navigation, anchoring, and safety. You focus on the shoot.

Pricing for the 2033 sunset session

The 2-hour sunset session is priced at €749 – that’s the total charter cost, not per person. This is a Tier A boat in our fleet (same pricing as the Azimut 39). For comparison:

BoatDurationPrice
Astondoa 40 (12.5m)2 hours€749
Azimut 39 (12.5m)2 hours€749
Mangusta 80 (24m)4 hours minimum€4,719 (includes jet ski)

For longer sessions or larger yachts, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. The €749 rate includes everything – no extra charges for cleaning, fuel, or VAT.

Best time for the photoshoot yacht sunset session in Marbella

Golden hour in Marbella runs from about 19:30 to 21:30 in June, July, and August. In September, it shifts to 19:00–20:30. The 2-hour charter covers the full transition from warm light to twilight. The skipper will position the boat so the sun sets behind the boat’s bow or stern, depending on your composition preference.

If you want a longer session (e.g., to include pre-sunset and post-sunset blue hour), you can book a 4-hour charter at the Tier A rate – that’s €1,498 total. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange that.

Route: where the photoshoot takes place

The standard route departs Puerto Banús and heads west along the coast towards Cabopino or east towards Cala del Faro. The skipper chooses based on wind direction and sunset angle. Both routes offer clear views of La Concha mountain to the north and the open Mediterranean to the south.

You’ll pass the Golden Mile’s beachfront villas and the Marbella Marina skyline. If you want a specific backdrop (e.g., the Puerto Banús skyline or the dunes of Cabopino), mention it at booking – the skipper can adjust the route.

What to bring for the shoot

  • Camera gear (no restrictions on tripods or gimbals – the deck is stable)
  • Light-coloured clothing (avoid dark prints that absorb light)
  • A jacket or windbreaker (temperature drops 5–8°C after sunset)
  • Sunscreen and sunglasses (pre-sunset UV is still strong)
  • Props (flowers, hats, champagne glasses – the boat has a cooler for drinks)

The boat has a small cabin with a toilet and a shaded saloon if you need to change or review shots mid-cruise.

Who this session is for

  • Influencers and content creators needing a cohesive sunset set
  • Couples planning engagement or anniversary photos
  • Small brands shooting lifestyle or travel content
  • Friends who want professional-looking holiday shots without a studio

If your group is larger than 9 guests, consider the Azimut 39 (11 pax) at the same price, or the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) for a premium setup. Both are available from Puerto Banús.

Booking and cancellation

Book via WhatsApp or the contact form on our Boat Rental Marbella page. You’ll receive a confirmation with departure time, meeting point (Puerto Banús, next to the Astondoa 40), and what to expect. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure.

If weather conditions are unsafe (strong wind or thunderstorms), we reschedule or refund in full. The skipper makes the call on the day.
